## Pediatric bronchoscopy {#pediatric-bronchoscopy}

**Partnerships for Global Surgery · 2026–present**

A pediatric rigid bronchoscope should remain usable and durable in hospitals with very different resources. I’m working with a clinical and engineering team on a reusable system targeting a cost below $10,000 and a service life of more than 100 uses. My focus includes the miniature endoscope: packaging a **2.0 mm camera** inside a **2.5 mm outer-diameter stainless-steel tube**, while assessing a sealed protective window, LED illumination, and cleaning methods. Optical design trade-offs include a roughly 120° camera field of view and a proposed ±30° viewing-direction adjustment.

*Current stage:* Design and prototype evaluation; the targets above are requirements, not verified final-device performance.

## Autonomous underwater robot {#autonomous-underwater-robot}

**Experimental Engineering · 2026**

Built an environmental sensing system around pressure, thermistor, pH, and light measurements and packaged the electronics for field deployment at Dana Point. I designed analog signal-conditioning circuits, supported waterproof mechanical integration, and used calibration and live serial data to debug the system. The deployed robot reached approximately **3 m** in the documented run. Pressure and light followed expected depth trends; a pH reading that railed became a useful lead for the next sensor iteration.

## Filament waste collection {#filament-waste-collection}

**Engineering Design and Manufacturing · 2025**

Worked with the Harvey Mudd Makerspace on a collection system for the 3D-printing lab. Our five-person team prototyped a perimeter track and chute interface using CAD, 3D printing, laser cutting, and machining. Steward trials on a six-printer prototype surfaced the next mechanical changes: tighter track tolerance and a lighter, stiffer drive system. A related disposal workflow reduced manual disposal time by approximately **50%** according to the resume project record.

## Multicycle RISC-V processor {#multicycle-risc-v-processor}

**Computer Engineering · 2025**

Implemented a hierarchical SystemVerilog multicycle processor with controller, datapath, ALU, register file, decoder, finite-state machine, and unified memory. Verified program counter, state transitions, ALU behavior, memory address, write data, and `MemWrite` cycle by cycle in simulation, ending with the expected memory write.

## Laser tag system {#laser-tag-system}

**Microprocessors project · 2026 · in progress**

Developing an infrared laser-tag game with two blasters and two vests. The system concept combines hit detection and three-life game logic, sound and LED feedback, and an ESP8266-based local scoreboard. The hardware architecture combines an STM32 MCU, FPGA, and a custom PCB; implementation and game testing are ongoing.

[Code and PCB repository](https://github.com/bphung-01/Laser_Tag_Code_PCB)
